body: The cold, dim glow of the loft cast long shadows across the stone floor, making it hard to see anything clearly. I could hear the faint rustling of paper coming from the desk in the corner, and a faint rustling of pages from the books stacked nearby. My heart raced as I realized that the light was burning bright, unlike the usual soft glow of the lamps in the choir hall.
